component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.inner = m.top.findNode("inner") m.outer = m.top.findNode("outer") m.reFocused = false
' 1) Set focus FIRST (as a screen does to place its initial focus). This writes focusedChild ' on the scene, on outer, and on inner - all queued for delivery after init. print "before setFocus" m.inner.setFocus(true)
' 2) Register the observers AFTER the focus call, still inside init(). m.top.observeField("focusedChild", "onSceneFocus") m.outer.observeField("focusedChild", "onOuterFocus") print "init done" end sub
' Delivered from the message loop after init. Re-focus outer once: this rewrites focusedChild on ' the scene/outer/inner inline. The delivery drain must not double-fire onOuterFocus. sub onSceneFocus() print "onSceneFocus fired" if m.reFocused = false m.reFocused = true m.outer.setFocus(true) end if end sub
sub onOuterFocus() print "onOuterFocus fired" end sub
